October 12, 2026

# Cart updates that result in no changes to the cart no longer trigger carts/update webhooks

DateOctober 12, 2026

FlagsUpdate

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[Ajax API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=ajax-api)[Storefront API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=storefront-graphql)

Cart operations that leave the cart unchanged, for example, resubmitting the same values a cart already has, no longer trigger a `carts/update` webhook. Shopify sends a webhook every time a cart's contents or properties change.

Previously, every cart operation produced a `carts/update` webhook. This change removes the duplicate notifications, and apps receive one `carts/update` for each change to a cart instead of one per request.

**Learn more**

* [Cart webhooks](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/webhooks/2026-04?accordionItem=webhooks-carts-update#list-of-topics-carts/update)
* [Ajax Cart API](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/ajax/reference/cart)
